about: Single source of Antoine constants for 2105603 (labs, slides, notes). Every real-fluid vapor pressure in the course uses a set from this file. Source: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69, Phase change data, Antoine Equation Parameters. Form: log10(Psat/bar) = A - B/(T/K + C). Rule: use the set whose range covers the temperatures of the problem; if two sets cover it, use the first listed for that compound.
form: log10(P/bar) = A - B/(T + C), T in K

sets.ref: Willingham, Taylor, Pignocco and Rossini (1945), J. Res. Natl. Bur. Stand. 35, 219-244
usedIn: labs/assets/systems.json (Lab 01 VLE and flash, adiabatic-flash lab)

sets.ref: Eon, Pommier et al. (1971), NIST fit to authors' data
usedIn: labs-next virial-graduate.js (virial-vapor lab at 360 K, above the 1945 range)
